{{Top|leg}}
'''Demolitionmech''' was the term used to describe any [[Droid/Legends|droid]] which was used to plant explosives or to defuse bombs. Originally used to describe the [[LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer/Legends|LIN series]] of mine-laying droids, the term became synonymous with any heavy-duty automaton that could perform the same task.
